Type: cabinet
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Checkerboard Reclaimed Elm Buffet Sideboard Credenza Cabinet, 55.1"W, Natural
Colors: Natural
Materials: Solid elm frame and legs
From checkerboard accent front to its tapered legs, this handsome cabinet makes a true mid-century statement. Storage compartments make it useful as an entertainment center, a focal point for a hallway or entryway, or even a dining room buffet. 55.1"W x 17.7"D x 31.5"H Reclaimed solid elm frame and legs A mid-century modern statement piece Soft closing drawers provide convenient storage for dishes, AV equipment and more No assembly required. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
